name: ServoX
summary: YZ-ServoX is a multi-axis robotics and automation control-development platform with four external motor-driver connections, eight CAN FD hardware channels, two RS485 interfaces, three EtherCAT ports on one ESC and 16 digital inputs/outputs. Motor power stages are external. Current screen-connected and screen-disconnected software configurations support different axis sets.

description.en: YZ-ServoX is a multi-axis robotics and automation control-development platform with four external motor-driver connections, eight CAN FD hardware channels, two RS485 interfaces, three EtherCAT ports on one ESC and 16 digital inputs/outputs. Motor power stages are external. Current screen-connected and screen-disconnected software configurations support different axis sets.

sources.title: ServoX 4轴伺服开发平台｜8路 CAN FD · EtherCAT（ECAT） · YeeZi 冶治科技
sources.quote:
主控
HPM6E8YIVM1
规格书硬件型号；SDK 的 HPM6E80 目标名称不用于替换硬件型号。

specs.label: Digital io
specs.conditions: DI uses NPN/dry-contact pull-down; DO uses N-MOS low-side open drain. Load current awaits board-level validation.

sources.title: ServoX 4轴伺服开发平台｜8路 CAN FD · EtherCAT（ECAT） · YeeZi 冶治科技
sources.quote:
数字 IO
16 DI / 16 DO
DI 为 NPN / 干接点下拉激活，DO 为 N-MOS 低侧开漏；负载电流尚待板级验证。

specs.label: Ethercat ports
specs.value: Three ports belonging to one ESC

sources.title: ServoX 4轴伺服开发平台｜8路 CAN FD · EtherCAT（ECAT） · YeeZi 冶治科技
sources.quote:
EtherCAT
一个 ESC 的 3 个端口

specs.formatted: Three ports belonging to one ESC

specs.label: Ethernet interface
specs.conditions: J2/ENET hardware does not imply a ready-to-use EtherCAT master.

sources.title: ServoX 4轴伺服开发平台｜8路 CAN FD · EtherCAT（ECAT） · YeeZi 冶治科技
sources.quote:
Ethernet
1 路独立千兆 Ethernet
J2 / ENET，10/100/1000 Mbit/s；有相应网络硬件不等于提供现成 EtherCAT 主站功能。

specs.label: External motor driver interfaces
specs.conditions: Mainboard does not contain four motor power bridges; external power-driver boards are required.

sources.title: ServoX 4轴伺服开发平台｜8路 CAN FD · EtherCAT（ECAT） · YeeZi 冶治科技
sources.quote:
功率驱动扩展
4 组 24 Pin 外部电机驱动板接口
主板不集成四路电机功率桥，电机需通过匹配的外部功率驱动板连接。

specs.label: Industrial bus interfaces
specs.conditions: Non-isolated CAN and RS485. Hardware resources do not imply firmware validation of all protocols.

sources.title: ServoX 4轴伺服开发平台｜8路 CAN FD · EtherCAT（ECAT） · YeeZi 冶治科技
sources.quote:
总线硬件
8 路 CAN FD / 2 路 RS485
硬件资源不代表当前固件完成全部协议验证；CAN、RS485 为非隔离。

specs.label: Nominal input voltage
specs.conditions: Nominal DC supply only; allowed operating range needs board-level validation.

sources.title: ServoX 4轴伺服开发平台｜8路 CAN FD · EtherCAT（ECAT） · YeeZi 冶治科技
sources.quote:
主输入电源
24 V DC 标称
允许工作范围尚需板级验证，不能把标称值扩展为电压范围。
